title: Shotgun engineering fires up mammalian metabolic design - Nature Biotechnology
text:
By testing random combinations of genes at scale, shotgun genetic engineering enables discovery of new productive metabolic pathways in mammalian cells, including solutions for synthesizing two essential amino acids.
